notes: Data from Tesla's 10-Q filed 2026-04-23 for Q1 2026 (3 months ended March 31, 2026), accession 0001628280-26-026673.
Revenue is total revenues ($22,387M) for the quarter.
Net income is the consolidated figure ($491M) including noncontrolling interests; $477M attributable to common stockholders.
Total assets as of March 31, 2026 from the consolidated balance sheet.
Capital expenditures ($2,493M) are 'purchases of property and equipment excluding finance leases, net of sales', treated as positive outflow.
Free cash flow = operating cash flow ($3,937M) - capital expenditures ($2,493M) = $1,444M.
